system.description:
You conjure a clone made of paper, similar to the Shadow Clone Technique constructed of special chakra reinforced paper to a space it can occupy within 10 feet of you, known as a Paper Clone, that weigh a fraction of its caster weight.

When this jutsu is cast, by spending 8 Chakra, you summon one Clone. You can spend 4 additional chakra to summon up to 1 additional Clone. You can maintain up to 2 Clones at a time.

Paper Clones have Immunity to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, Vulnerability to fire damage and can cast up to two C-Rank and lower Shikigami Clan Hijutsu before this jutsu ends.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost by 3 and the increase the number of Paper clones you can summon and maintain, by +1.
